ReportFileFormat.description: The format of the bindings scan report file.

description:
One check request. Each switch field selects one category; a check that selects
none runs the default categories.

base.description: Compare Git HEAD with this commit instead of its first parent.

baseline.description: Bindings check only: resolve evidence anchors against this earlier scan report. Needs scope.

bindings.description: Run only Rule binding checks. The scan covers the repository root; path limits it.

docs.description: Run only the docs check: report each Markdown link that names a page the docs site does not publish.

gaps.description: Run only the gaps check: report the unfinished parts of the graph and each Rule without a Source. These findings do not fail the check.

graph.description: Run only graph validity checks. Combine with other check selectors.

output.description: Bindings check only: write the scan report of the selected scope to this file. Needs scope.

path.description: Bindings check only: scan the files below this path. The default is the repository root.

scope.description: Check only this scope. The default is every scope that the caller can read.

statement.description: Check this statement instead of the committed statements.

statements.description: Run only statement quality checks. Combine with other check selectors.

strict.description: Reject findings in statements committed at Git HEAD, and every bindings finding.

title: CheckInput
